name: eng-2143-obsidian
title: Round-trip Roam and Obsidian source references (Obsidian)
claim: In Obsidian, a Source relation survives the round trip: what Roam shares comes in as a relation to its Source, a missing or unavailable source warns without blocking and creates no placeholder, the earliest of several Source relations is pushed, and repeating the push or the fetch changes nothing.
given: Sid-Obsidian-test runs the ENG-2143 build, signed in to the proof database with sync mode on, and has Evidence and Source types joined by a derived-from relation. The dev graph published a Source with an Evidence node that cites it, an Evidence node with no source, and an Evidence node citing a Source the group cannot see. The vault holds an Evidence note with two Source relations (the later one listed first), their two Source notes, and an Evidence note with no source. The Roam half is in the eng-2143 kit.

prepare.why: the vault has a proof database session, so sync writes to the proof database
sync mode is on, so Sync discourse nodes to Supabase and the import commands run

apply.js: (async () => { const plugin = proof.obsidian.plugin(); plugin.settings.syncModeEnabled = true; await plugin.saveSettings(); })()

prepare.why: the dev graph published a Source, an Evidence node that cites it, an Evidence node with no source, a second Source, and an Evidence node that cites that one, to the eng-2329-demo group (this stands in for Roam's own push, which the Roam kit proves)

apply.js: (async () => { await proof.obsidian.closeModals(); const plugin = proof.obsidian.plugin(); const s = plugin.settings; const now = Date.now(); const ensure = (name, format, color) => { let t = s.nodeTypes.find((x) => x.name === name && !x.importedFromRid); if (!t) { t = { id: 'pk-2143-' + name.toLowerCase(), name, format, color, created: now, modified: now }; s.nodeTypes.push(t); } return t; }; const evd = ensure('Evidence', 'EVD - {content}', '#DB134A'); const src = ensure('Source', 'SRC - {content}', '#9E9E9E'); let rel = s.relationTypes.find((r) => r.label === 'derived from' && !r.importedFromRid); if (!rel) { rel = { id: 'pk-2143-derived-from', label: 'derived from', complement: 'has derivation', color: 'blue', created: now, modified: now }; s.relationTypes.push(rel); } if (!s.discourseRelations.some((r) => r.sourceId === evd.id && r.destinationId === src.id && r.relationshipTypeId === rel.id && !r.importedFromRid)) s.discourseRelations.push({ id: 'pk-2143-evd-src', sourceId: evd.id, destinationId: src.id, relationshipTypeId: rel.id, created: now, modified: now });  await plugin.saveSettings(); })()

expect.js: (async () => { proof.assert(!/Sync failed/.test(proof.obsidian.notices()), 'Sync failed: ' + proof.obsidian.notices()); const key = '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}'; const get = (id) => proof.waitFor(async () => (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id,reference_content&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.106039&source_local_id=eq.' + id, { key }))[0], { what: 'the synced concept ' + id, timeout: 30000, interval: 1000 });  const late = await get('pk-2143-vault-src-late'); const ghost = await get('pk-2143-vault-evd-ghost'); proof.assert(!ghost.reference_content || ghost.reference_content.sourceDocument === undefined, 'The sourceDocument is ' + JSON.stringify(ghost.reference_content) + ' (the later Source is ' + late.id + ').'); })()
